title: Cancellation notice regarding filling up of0 posts (4 posts by Direct Recruitment and 6 posts by Deputation) in IPC
bodyHtml:
Cancellation Notice

It is notified for information to all concerned that an advertisement No. IPC/1110/2019-20 relating to recruitment for filling up 10 posts of Scientific Officer (04 Direct Recruitment Basis and 06 Deputation Basis) in Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission, Ghaziabad published in Employment News edition dated 29th June - 05th July 2019, published in various leading News Papers and website of the Commission stand cancelled.

(Manish Jain)

Senior Administrative Officer
